name: Jeff Landry
stance: Signed the 2025 governors' letter against a federal moratorium, but his office did not deny pressing legislators to shelve 2026 AI bills after Trump's funding threat.

statements.text: Signed the 17-governor letter asking Congress to drop the state AI-law moratorium.
statements.outlet: Office of the Governor of Arkansas

statements.text: Rep. Vincent Cox said he shelved two AI bills at the governor's office's request; Landry's spokesperson declined to confirm whether the Trump broadband threat was the reason.
